description:
BenchBox caps pyspark `<4.3` (PR #4241) because no delta-spark release supports Spark 4.3: with 4.3.0 locked, uv resolves delta-spark 4.1.0 and Delta sessions fail with `unresolved dependency: io.delta#delta-spark_4.3_2.13;4.1.0: not found` (24 live_delta errors). Everything else passed on 4.3.0 (fast tier 39,230; 55 PySpark files 2,084; no answer changes; JDK 17/21/25 work, CI uses 21).

Found while testing 4.3.0, to handle at the raise:
- The pyspark 4.3.0 wheel reports `pyspark.__version__ == "4.1.0"` while its jars are 4.3.0; BenchBox records `pyspark.__version__` as `client_library_version`, so results would show the wrong client version. Read the version from the jars/`SparkContext.version` or package metadata instead.
- `SUPPORTED_JAVA_VERSIONS` lacks 25, which Spark 4.3 supports.

Trigger: a delta-spark release on PyPI accepting pyspark 4.3 and a `delta-spark_4.3_2.13` artifact on Maven. Scratch setup: ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/pyspark-4-3/ (venv42, chain.sh, run1.sh).

Guardrails: one engine per PR; no reference-answer regeneration; timings via make heavy-run, TPC-H SF1 pyspark-df 4.2 vs 4.3 best of 3.
